title: Corporate VC is Not the Devil
primary_theme: Corporate Venture Capital as Strategic Edge When Alignment Is Real
founder_lessons: Assess investor-company fit, including fund size, ownership goals, and stage alignment.
Come prepared with a crisp narrative, clear risks, and mitigation points the investor can repeat internally.
Treat corporate investors as potential distribution and domain-expertise partners, but test alignment and follow-on behavior.
Coach your deal champion to tell the story when you are not in the partnership meeting.
notable_quotes: Capital is a commodity. So you need a real edge.
CVCs can pack a punch way above their weight class relative to traditional VC
the ability to coach an investor on how to tell the story is a cool skill.
